blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Metrotown. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Metrotown, Burnaby: 14 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 7 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 50%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 14 of 35 Burnaby communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Metrotown fell from 17 in June to 14 in September (−17.6%), and 16 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 3.1% of Burnaby’s 458 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Metrotown?
Metrotown also had 341 condos and townhomes listed and 35 sold in September, against 14 houses listed. The Metrotown condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Metrotown?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 14 houses listed in Metrotown. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Metrotown a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Metrotown had a sales ratio of 50%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Metrotown from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 16 houses sold in Metrotown over those 4 months, out of 199 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Metrotown?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
